On April 25, 2019, the General Staff (Staff) of the Arkansas Public Service
Commission (Commission) filed its Amended Motion to Establish Procedural Schedule
(Motion).
Staff states that it has conferred with the other parties to this Docket and
proposes the following amended procedural schedule:
Staff/Intervenor Direct Testimony
EAL Rebuttal Testimony
Staff/Inter^enor Surrebuttal Testimony
EAL Sur-Surrebuttal Testimony
Hearing
The Commission finds that the amended procedural schedule is reasonable and
in the public interest. The Motion is hereby granted. All filings are to be made by noon
on the day of the deadline.
The hearing on EAL's Motion for Approval of Revised
Estimate of Arkansas Nuclear One Decommissioning Costs is scheduled to begin at
9:30 a.m. on Tuesday, Septeinber 10, 2019, in the Commission Hearing Room
located in the Arkansas Public Service Commission Building, 1000 Center Street, Little
Rock, Arkansas.
